programme.coaching_intent: General ten-week 10K PB programme for a fit, competent runner
programme.description: Your 5K result must be no more than 56 local calendar days old when you start this workout. If you have a newer qualifying result, update your input and review the targets. Otherwise, this workout remains unavailable. This programme does not add a 5K test. Threshold workouts also support the separately selected manual-threshold option. A workout already started keeps its accepted targets.
